documents.title: SENTINEL demo rack profiles
documents.content: Rack profile thresholds (temperature_warning_c, temperature_critical_c, humidity_*_percent) are fictional settings created for the SENTINEL hackathon demo. They are not manufacturer specifications and are not derived from any vendor documentation.

documents.title: SENTINEL rover sensor notes
documents.content: The rover measures ambient temperature and relative humidity near the rack, raw sound intensity (SOUND_RAW, an uncalibrated microphone level, not decibels), and ultrasonic distance in cm to the nearest surface in front of the sensor. Rover ambient temperature is not equipment inlet or component temperature. The rover cannot read fan RPM, CPU utilization, power draw, interface errors, or hardware health.
